package.notes: YouTube Community photos now upload and publish automatically in your connected running Chrome. Individual Send and Send to all support 7- and 10-photo posts, caption entry, one Publish click and verified new post links. No manual link-paste or photo-upload step. Connect Chrome locally and keep Windows unlocked. Real-account acceptance still needs a supervised first post; no real account was used by automated tests.

local_browser_cases: uncertain result dispatches Publish exactly once and never claims success

behavior: New DARSHANFLOW YouTube photo drafts use browser delivery rather than manual handoff
Existing consented running Chrome only; never opens a new login profile
Visible account verification, caption entry, ordered local JPG upload, one Publish click and a matching new permalink receipt
Individual Send and reviewed Send to all execute the same publisher
Photos are integrity checked and copied into temporary numbered JPG paths; no download UI
Old manual drafts can explicitly create a new automatic review; old manual receipts stay retained
Wrong identity, existing composer, altered photos/text, ambiguous controls or uncertain results stop for review; no automatic repeat
WhatsApp sharing remains a separate manual step
requirements: My running Chrome selected and Chrome browser-control permission granted locally
Intended channel primary owner in Chrome; Advanced account settings must show the exact selected channel ID
real_account_acceptance: NOT performed. The real YouTube website/account has not been used to validate the current DOM variant. First publication needs supervised acceptance on the operator PC. Fixture success does not establish compatibility with every YouTube UI variant.
